shutdown_behavior.details: Both measured SGLang monolithic parents received SIGTERM. Their scheduler children exited with signal 15, the parent entered its SIGQUIT diagnostics and kill_process_tree path, and the owned process group exceeded the 45 second shutdown deadline. The lifecycle then used SIGKILL. Both fleet release checks found zero compute processes. The measured requests had already completed.
